description: This is a test class for the AnySoftKeyboard Android keyboard application, specifically testing the view-related functionalities such as settings dialog interactions, incognito mode toggling, input view clipping issues, and view reset behavior.

classes.name: AnySoftKeyboardViewRelatedTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing view-related behaviors of the AnySoftKeyboard Android keyboard, including dialog interactions, incognito mode, view clipping, and view reset functionalities.

methods.name: testSettingsBasic
methods.description: Tests that the settings dialog opens correctly and displays the expected title and list count.

methods.name: testSettingsIncognito
methods.description: Verifies toggling incognito mode updates the watermark drawable and internal state accordingly.

methods.name: testSettingsOverrideDictionary
methods.description: Checks that the override dictionary setting opens the correct dialog and that its buttons have assigned listeners.

methods.name: testSetInputViewClippingIssues
methods.description: Ensures that in non-fullscreen mode, the input view's window and parent view have correct layout parameters and gravity.

methods.name: testSetInputViewClippingIssuesInLandscape
methods.description: Verifies input view layout parameters and gravity in landscape mode with specific configuration.

methods.name: testResetViewOnAddOnChange
methods.description: Checks that the input view is correctly reset after critical add-on changes.
